s1_empty_tray.prompt: Editorial macro photograph of a tilt-shift miniature diorama on a light grey desk, HO-scale model figurines, vertical composition. The upper third of the frame is plain empty light grey desk surface, soft and clean. In the lower two thirds: a white wire document tray with a small neat black label «ЗАПИТИ БАНКУ», the tray is completely empty. Beside it lies a long printed bank statement with the header «ВИПИСКА З РАХУНКУ» and neat columns of numbers. Three tiny figures in dark business suits calmly study the statement: one holds a big magnifying glass over a row, two others carry a turquoise highlighter as big as a log and draw a turquoise line under one row. Soft daylight, calm, precise, tidy, reassuring. White paper, light grey, graphite details, turquoise #30D5C8 as the only accent colour.
